entities.name: PMID:34587639
observations: Compared thrombus formation in platelet-FVIII 2bF8trans mice on an FVIII-null background with wild-type and FVIII-null mice.

entities.name: Platelet FVIII thrombus profile
observations: In mice, platelet-targeted FVIII produced thrombi more stable than FVIII-null controls at physiological shear, with no statistically significant difference in clot strength/stability versus wild type; at pathological shear, thrombi were smaller and had less fibrin than wild type. The abstract reports no increase in thrombosis; outcomes were experimental thrombus properties, not spontaneous-event incidence.
